# Local LLM MCP Server — Full Reference

A production-grade FastMCP 3.4.4+ server for managing local and cloud Large Language Models.
Combines a unified AI gateway (28 providers), 12 portmanteau MCP tools, a SOTA React/Vite web
dashboard, and provider health monitoring with circuit breakers.

## Quick Reference

| Aspect | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Package | `llm-mcp` (PyPI) |
| Entry | `uv run -m llm_mcp` or `llm-mcp` CLI |
| FastMCP | `>=3.4.4,<4` |
| Python | `>=3.12` |
| Transport | stdio (default), HTTP (`MCP_TRANSPORT=http`) |
| HTTP port | 10833 (also `MCP_PORT`) |
| Dashboard | http://localhost:10832 |
| License | MIT |

## Port Map

| Port | Service |
|------|---------|
| 10832 | Dashboard frontend (Vite dev server) |
| 10833 | Dashboard API (FastAPI) + MCP HTTP + Gateway |
| 11434 | Ollama (external) |
| 1234 | LM Studio (external) |
| 8000 | vLLM (external, Docker) |

## Tool Surface

All tools return `{"success": bool, "message": str, "data": dict}`.

### llm_health — System health and management

Operations: `health_check`, `provider_check`, `shutdown`, `system_info`, `service_status`,
`server_health`, `get_metrics`, `get_metric_stats`, `set_log_level`, `collect_metrics`,
`list_tools`, `tool_help`, `search_tools`, `tool_signature`, `hardware_requirements`

- `shutdown` requires `confirm=True` (safety guard)
- `health_check` returns aggregated score (0-100) with per-service breakdown
- `provider_check` probes Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM via ProviderHealthService (60s cache)
- `list_tools` has 3 detail levels: 0=names, 1=basic, 2=full with docstrings

### llm_models — Model discovery and registration

Operations: `list_models`, `get_model_info`, `register_model`, `unregister_model`,
`update_model`, `get_model_stats`

- `list_models` aggregates across all configured providers
- `register_model` accepts `provider`, `name`, `context_length`, `max_tokens`, `parameters`

### llm_generation — Text generation and embeddings

Operations: `generate_text`, `chat_completion`, `embed_text`, `stream_generate`

- Accepts `model`, `prompt`, `messages`, `temperature`, `max_tokens`, `top_p`, `stream`
- `embed_text` returns vector embeddings via configured provider

### llm_multimodal — Image analysis and generation

Operations: `analyze_image`, `generate_image`, `compare_images`

- `analyze_image`: accepts base64 image data, uses LLaVA/CLIP-based models
- `generate_image`: uses Stable Diffusion pipeline (via diffusers)
- Hardcoded model mapping: vision → `llava-hf/llava-1.5-7b-hf`, diffusion → `stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0`

### llm_finetuning — LoRA/DoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning

Operations: `lora_load_adapter`, `lora_unload_adapter`, `lora_list_adapters`,
`sparse_apply`, `sparse_list`, `dora_apply`, `dora_list`

- Requires `peft`, `bitsandbytes`, `datasets` dependencies
- Per-operation parameter validation with structured errors

### llm_ollama — Ollama-specific operations

Operations: `list_models`, `pull_model`, `delete_model`, `load_model`, `unload_model`

- Delegates to `OllamaManager` in `model_management_tools.py`
- `pull_model` streams download progress
- Each operation invalidates relevant FastMCP tool cache

### llm_lmstudio — LM Studio + LM Link

Operations: `list_models`, `load_model`, `unload_model`, `eject_model`, `link_status`

- `link_status` probes `lms link status --json` via async subprocess
- Returns: peers list, device_name, peer_count, link_state, preferred_device
- Graceful fallback when `lms` CLI is absent

### llm_vllm — vLLM server management

Operations: `list_models`, `get_server_status`, `start_server`, `stop_server`,
`get_config`, `update_config`

- Docker lifecycle management via `VLLMDockerManager`
- Starts/stops vLLM containers with GPU passthrough
- `update_config` supports live engine reconfiguration

### llm_huggingface — Hugging Face hub operations

Operations: `list_models`, `search_models`, `download_model`, `get_model_details`,
`list_datasets`

- Direct `huggingface_hub` API integration
- `download_model` caches to local `models/` directory

### llm_google_cloud — Google Cloud AI operations

Operations: `generate_text`, `list_models`, `generate_content`, `embed_text`

- Requires Google Cloud credentials (`google-cloud-aiplatform`)
- Gateway adapter at `gateway/adapters/`

### llm_gpu — NVIDIA GPU management

Operations: `get_status`, `clear_memory`, `optimize`, `get_health`

- Uses `nvidia-smi` via subprocess and `pynvml` bindings
- `clear_memory` frees unused GPU allocations (RTX 4090 optimized)
- `optimize` adjusts memory fragmentation

### llm_engine — Engine supervision (Ollama + llama.cpp server)

Operations: `status`, `start`, `stop`, `list_models`, `load_model`, `unload_model`

- Supervises both local engines: the Ollama daemon (port 11434) and the native
  llama.cpp server (server 11439, truncating proxy 11435 - Muse Glimmer 30B)
- `status` reports processes, ports, health, loaded models, and per-engine VRAM
- `start`/`stop` launch and kill engine processes (llama server + proxy, or Ollama)
- `list_models`: Ollama catalog via `/api/tags`, llama server via `/v1/models`
- `load_model`/`unload_model`: Ollama keep_alive control; for llama the server
  holds one fixed model, so load = start, unload = stop
- Process discovery uses PowerShell CIM (psutil enumeration hangs on this machine);
  Windows-only for process operations

### llm_help — Tool discovery and documentation

Operations: `list_tools`, `get_tool_help`, `search_tools`, `get_tool_signature`,
`get_workflow_guides`, `get_performance_guide`, `get_troubleshooting_guide`,
`get_hardware_requirements`, `get_quick_reference`, `get_integration_guide`

- `list_tools` supports 5 detail levels (0-4)
- `search_tools` uses relevance-scored keyword matching

## AI Gateway (Lightport-compatible)

`POST /v1/chat/completions` — OpenAI-compatible proxy at `http://127.0.0.1:10833/v1`.

### Provider Selection

1. **Header**: `x-lightport-provider: anthropic` (explicit selection)
2. **Model prefix**: `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514` (auto-routes to provider)
3. **Default**: First available provider

### Supported Providers

Local: Ollama (`ollama`), LM Studio (`lmstudio`), vLLM (`vllm`)
Cloud (28): Anthropic, Anyscale, Azure, Bedrock, Cohere, DeepInfra, DeepSeek,
Featherless, Fireworks, Gemini, Groq, Hyperbolic, Lepton, Mistral, Modal,
Nebius, Novita, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Perplexity, Replicate, SambaNova,
SiliconFlow, Together, xAI (Grok)

### Gateway Architecture

Each provider has a dedicated adapter under `src/llm_mcp/gateway/adapters/`:

```
base.py           — ProviderAdapter ABC with async chat completion signature
router.py         — FastAPI router mounting POST /v1/chat/completions
adapters/         — 28 provider implementations registered via @register_provider("name")
__init__.py       — Auto-discovers and registers all adapters
```

## REST API Endpoints

All served from `http://127.0.0.1:10833`:

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/health` | GET | Basic health check |
| `/api/v1/health` | GET | Fleet-standard health + provider status + LM Link |
| `/api/v1/diagnostics` | GET | CUA-NSIS diagnostics (tool count, providers, system) |
| `/api/v1/config` | GET | Server configuration |
| `/api/v1/config` | PUT | Update configuration |
| `/api/v1/models` | GET | List available models |
| `/api/v1/generate` | POST | Text generation |
| `/api/v1/telemetry` | GET | Performance telemetry |
| `/v1/chat/completions` | POST | OpenAI-compatible chat (gateway) |
| `/api/v1/mcp-servers` | GET | Registered MCP servers |
| `/api/v1/mcp-servers/{name}` | GET/PUT/DELETE | MCP server CRUD |
| `/api/v1/logging` | GET | Log ring buffer |

## Provider Health Service

Location: `src/llm_mcp/services/provider_health.py`

### Architecture
- `ProviderHealth` dataclass: `ok`, `reachable`, `model_count`, `error`, `latency_ms`, `provider`
- `ProviderCircuitBreaker`: 3 consecutive failures → 60s cooldown
- 60s in-memory cache (`_cached_health` dict with expiry)
- Concurrent health checks via `asyncio.gather()`

### Endpoints Covered
- Ollama: `GET http://localhost:11434/api/tags`
- LM Studio: `GET http://localhost:1234/v1/models`
- LM Link: `lms link status --json` (async subprocess)

### Response Shape
```json
{
  "provider": "ollama",
  "reachable": true,
  "model_count": 5,
  "latency_ms": 42,
  "ok": true,
  "error": null
}
```

## Startup and Transport

`src/llm_mcp/transport.py` provides unified dual transport:

| Env Var | Values | Default |
|---------|--------|---------|
| `MCP_TRANSPORT` | `stdio`, `http`, `sse` | `stdio` |
| `MCP_HOST` | IP address | `127.0.0.1` |
| `MCP_PORT` | Port number | `10833` |
| `MCP_PATH` | HTTP path | `/mcp` |

In HTTP mode, FastMCP serves its tool protocol at `http://{host}:{port}/mcp`.

## Web Dashboard (React 19 + Vite 6)

### Pages
- Dashboard — KPI cards (server, tools, CPU, memory), provider health cards, LM Link status
- Chat — Skill-aware conversation, 4+ personalities, export/clear, speech TTS/STT
- Performance — GPU VRAM, system RAM, latency telemetry charts
- Vision — Multimodal model inference
- Fleet — MCP ecosystem app discovery
- Analytics — Usage statistics and metrics
- Settings — Provider config, LLM auto-detection (Ollama/LM Studio/vLLM), server settings
- Help — Architecture overview, port map, env vars, troubleshooting

### Start
```powershell
# Full stack: backend + frontend
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File web_sota/start.ps1
# Or: just serve (MCP server only, stdio mode)
```

## LM Link Integration (Tailscale + LM Studio)

LM Link is LM Studio's encrypted mesh for remote LLM access over Tailscale (Feb 2026).

- `llm_lmstudio(operation="link_status")` probes `lms link status --json`
- Returns: `peers[]`, `device_name`, `peer_count`, `link_state`, `preferred_device`
- Provider health endpoints (`/api/v1/health`, `/api/v1/diagnostics`) include `lm_link`
- Cross-repo: tailscale-mcp provides LM Link control plane (enable/disable, device naming)

## Session Context Injection

Tool-awareness prompts injected at IDE session start:

| IDE | File | Content |
|-----|------|---------|
| Claude Code | `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` + `hooks/hooks.json` | SessionStart text hook |
| Cursor | `.cursorrules` | ## Session Context (Local LLM MCP) |
| Windsurf | `.windsurfrules` | Same as .cursorrules |
| GitHub Copilot | `.github/copilot-instructions.md` | Tool-awareness prompt |
| OpenCode | `.opencode/skills/session-context/SKILL.md` | YAML-frontmattered skill |

## Features by Severity

### Core (always available)
- 12 portmanteau MCP tools
- Provider health service with circuit breaker
- Web dashboard (9 pages)
- REST API (12 endpoints)
- AI gateway (/v1/chat/completions, 28 providers)
- Dual transport (stdio + HTTP)
- Graceful shutdown with cleanup

### ML-dependent (requires torch/transformers)
- Text generation, chat, embeddings
- Multimodal (vision) inference
- LoRA/DoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning
- HuggingFace hub operations

### Optional (env-flag gated)
- Legacy individual tools (`LLM_MCP_ENABLE_LEGACY_TOOLS=true`)
- vLLM inference (requires Docker + GPU)
- Google Cloud AI (requires GCP credentials)

## Tool Annotations

| Tool | Annotation | Rationale |
|------|-----------|-----------|
| `llm_health_tool` | MUTATING | Includes `shutdown` (destructive) |
| `llm_models_tool` | MUTATING | register/unregister changes state |
| `llm_generation_tool` | MUTATING | Generates new content |
| `llm_multimodal_tool` | MUTATING | Generates images |
| `llm_ollama_tool` | MUTATING | pull/delete/load/unload models |
| `llm_engine_control_tool` | MUTATING | start/stop engines, load/unload models |
| `llm_engine_status_tool` | READ_ONLY | engine status: processes, ports, VRAM, loaded models |
| `llm_lmstudio_tool` | MUTATING | load/unload/eject models |
| `llm_vllm_tool` | MUTATING | start/stop servers |
| `llm_huggingface_tool` | MUTATING | Download/cache management |
| `llm_google_cloud_tool` | MUTATING | API calls consume quota |
| `llm_gpu_tool_portmanteau` | MUTATING | clear_memory, optimize |
| `llm_help_tool_portmanteau` | READ_ONLY | Documentation only |
| `health_check` | READ_ONLY | Read-only status |

## Development Commands

```powershell
just bootstrap    # uv sync + pre-commit install + npm ci
just lint         # ruff check + biome ci
just fix          # ruff --fix + ruff format + biome check --write
just test         # pytest tests/
just serve        # uv run -m llm_mcp
just certify      # lint + test
just mcpb-pack    # build MCPB bundle
just check-sec    # bandit security audit
just audit-deps   # safety dependency audit
```

## Error Handling

- `_error_response()` in `tool_utils.py` auto-logs exceptions via `logger.exception()`
- Circuits breakers prevent cascading provider failures
- Graceful degradation: tool failures don't crash the server
- Signal-based graceful shutdown (SIGINT/SIGTERM)

## Dependencies

Core: fastmcp>=3.4.4, pydantic>=2.8, fastapi>=0.110, uvicorn, httpx, aiohttp
ML: torch>=2.4, transformers>=4.44, vllm>=0.8, accelerate, peft, bitsandbytes
Gateway: openai>=1.35, anthropic>=0.31
Web: React 19, Vite 6, TailwindCSS 3.4, Lucide React, Framer Motion
Quality: ruff, biome, pytest, pre-commit

## REST API Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|
| /health | GET | Liveness probe ({"status": "ok"}) |
| /api/v1/health | GET | Fleet-standard health: uptime, providers, LM Link |
| /api/v1/diagnostics | GET | CUA-NSIS diagnostics (tool count, providers, system) |
| /api/v1/tools | GET | Live MCP tool catalog (dynamic, powers the Tools page) |
| /api/v1/skills | GET | List server skills (skills/<name>/SKILL.md) |
| /api/v1/skills/{name} | GET | Raw SKILL.md content |
| /api/v1/models | GET | Model list from provider registry + direct probes |
| /api/v1/providers | GET | Provider info |
| /api/v1/generate | POST | Text generation |
| /v1/chat/completions | POST | OpenAI-compatible gateway (28 providers) |
| /v1/gateway/providers | GET | Gateway provider list |
| /api/v1/config | GET/PATCH | Server configuration |
| /api/logs | GET/DELETE | Activity log ring buffer (web backend) |
